name: Khan Hratha
summary: Uthek the Wise recalls how you helped the Gelkis against the Magram, and now asks you to strike at the Maraudine by slaying their clan's leader, Khan Hratha. Hratha holds a piece of a key, and Uthek wants it brought to him.

sections.title: Challenging the Maraudine
sections.body: Uthek the Wise says the Gelkis now need help against the Maraudine. The Maraudine War Horn stands on a tall bluff in the Valley of Spears, and sounding it is how Khan Hratha is called out. Yet the horn is useless without a warhorn mouthpiece, which is rare and carried only by trusted Maraudine centaur. When the horn sounds, more centaur arrive, and Hratha comes last.

sections.title: A Piece of a Key
sections.body: Khan Hratha holds a piece of a key, and Uthek wants it brought to Gelkis Village.

sections.title: On Your Return
sections.body: On your return, Uthek exults that Hratha is dead and the Maraudine are doomed. He vows that the Gelkis will remember you once they rule this land, and that the earth's spirits will sing your name forever.

faq.q: Who sends you to fight Khan Hratha?
faq.answer: Uthek the Wise, at Gelkis Village in Desolace, asks it of those who have helped the Gelkis.

faq.q: How is Khan Hratha brought out to fight?
faq.answer: Uthek points you to the Maraudine War Horn in the Valley of Spears, which has to be sounded. Centaur answer it, and Hratha follows.

faq.q: How do you blow the Maraudine War Horn?
aliases: how to use maraudine war horn
faq.answer: The horn is useless without a warhorn mouthpiece, and only trusted Maraudine centaur carry those, rarely.
It follows Khan Jehn. Uthek reminds you that you helped the Gelkis against the Magram.
